blocks.text: 加利福尼亚州库比蒂诺 Apple今日宣布推出全新的搭载M6的14英寸MacBook Pro，为大学生、商务用户、创作者等带来更强劲的性能、强大的端侧AI能力和更快的连接性。M6配备先进的12核CPU，拥有全球最快的CPU核心，因此从生产力任务到要求更高的专业工作流程，一切都感觉极其快速和响应灵敏。1 与M5相比，12核GPU的图形性能提升最高可达30%，AI工作负载速度提升最高可达25%，使搭载M6的14英寸MacBook Pro成为需要强大性能的用户的超值之选。2 对于从M1升级的用户，性能提升更为显著，图形性能最高提升可达11倍，AI性能最高提升可达13倍。3 凭借GPU中额外的神经加速器和双16核神经网络引擎，M6将MacBook Pro打造成更强大的AI平台——从在各应用和macOS中利用Siri AI和Apple Intelligence功能，到在本地运行LLM，同时保护用户隐私。4 此外，14英寸MacBook Pro支持Wi-Fi 7和蓝牙6，超快存储让处理大文件、导出项目和运行高要求的AI工作流程飞速完成。凭借最长可达24小时的出色电池续航，无论插电还是使用电池，它都能提供同样卓越的性能，让用户随时随地工作、创作和追求热爱。3 它还提供用户喜爱的先进功能，包括配备纳米纹理选项的惊艳Liquid Retina XDR显示屏、12MP Center Stage摄像头、沉浸式六扬声器音响系统和丰富的端口。结合macOS 27，全新的搭载M6的14英寸MacBook Pro对现有Mac用户和首次接触Mac的用户而言都是一次重大升级。提供深空黑色和银色两种配色，明天10月28日起可预订，11月6日星期五开始发售。

惊人的电池续航
：除了性能的大幅跃升，从 Intel 机型升级的用户电池续航最多增加 14 小时，从 M1 升级的用户最多增加 4 小时，总续航最长可达 24 小时，让用户一次充电完成更多工作。从 Intel 和 M1 系统升级的用户还将获得 16GB 起步统一内存、额外的 Thunderbolt 端口，以及采用阳极氧化密封工艺、更少指纹的深空黑色外观。
出色的专业显示屏
：惊艳的 Liquid Retina XDR 显示屏提供高达 1600 尼特的峰值 HDR 亮度和 1,000,000:1 的对比度，以深邃的黑色、明亮的高光和鲜艳的色彩让 HDR 照片和视频栩栩如生。对于在明亮或严苛光照条件下工作的用户，纳米纹理显示屏选项可大幅减少反射和眩光。
强大的连接能力
：14 英寸 MacBook Pro 现配备 Wi-Fi 7 和蓝牙 6，提供快速的无线性能和低延迟，并支持最多两台外接显示器。其丰富的端口阵列——包括 HDMI、MagSafe 3 和三个 Thunderbolt 4 端口、一个 SDXC 卡插槽和一个耳机插孔——让连接高速外设、传输照片或扩展工作空间变得轻松便捷。
先进的摄像头、麦克风和扬声器
：1200 万像素 Center Stage 摄像头配合桌面视角功能，帮助用户在视频通话中始终保持完美构图；录音室级三麦克风阵列和出色的六扬声器空间音频系统带来沉浸式音频体验。
快速充电
：搭载 M6 的 MacBook Pro 支持快速充电，搭配兼容的更高瓦数 USB-C 电源适配器（如 96W 电源适配器）时，仅需 30 分钟即可充至 50% 电量。3
经久耐用的笔记本电脑
：MacBook Pro 的外壳采用 100% 再生铝制成，极为耐用，可经受未来多年的日常使用。
与 iPhone 配合更出色
：与连续互通配合使用时，iPhone 和 Mac 更加强大——让用户能够在设备间无缝切换，共享文件和照片、接力任务，甚至通过 14 英寸 MacBook Pro 控制自己的 iPhone。5 首次改用 Mac 的用户可以使用 iPhone 便捷、安全地迁移设置、文件、照片、密码等内容。

inlines.text: Supercharged by the all-new M6 chip, the 14-inch MacBook Pro brings extraordinary performance, AI capabilities, and up to 24 hours of battery life — making it an even more compelling value.

blocks.text: CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA Apple today announced the new 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6, delivering even more performance, powerful on-device AI capabilities, and faster connectivity for college students, business users, creators, and more. M6 features an advanced 12-core CPU with the world’s fastest CPU core, so everything from productivity tasks to more demanding pro workflows feels incredibly fast and responsive.1 The 12-core GPU delivers up to 30 percent faster graphics and up to 25 percent faster AI workloads when compared to M5, making the 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 a compelling value for users who need serious power.2 For those upgrading from M1, the performance gains are even more significant, with up to 11x faster graphics and up to 13x faster AI performance.3 With additional Neural Accelerators in the GPU and a Dual 16-core Neural Engine, M6 turns MacBook Pro into an even more powerful platform for AI — from taking advantage of Siri AI and Apple Intelligence features across apps and macOS to running LLMs locally, all while preserving user privacy.4 In addition, the 14-inch MacBook Pro features Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6, while superfast storage makes working with large files, exporting projects, and running demanding AI workflows fly. And with phenomenal battery life of up to 24 hours, it delivers the same remarkable performance whether plugged in or on battery, so users can work, create, and pursue their passions from anywhere.3 It also offers the advanced features users love, including the stunning Liquid Retina XDR display with a nano-texture option, a 12MP Center Stage camera, an immersive six-speaker sound system, and a wide array of ports. Together with macOS 27, the new 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 is a major upgrade for existing Mac users and those coming to Mac for the first time. Available in space black and silver, it can be pre-ordered beginning tomorrow, October 28, with availability starting Friday, November 6.

inlines.text: M6: Blazing-Fast Performance and On-Device AI Capabilities

blocks.text: M6 brings even more performance and next-level AI capabilities to the 14-inch MacBook Pro. Featuring a powerful 12-core CPU, a 12-core GPU with Neural Accelerators in each core, Dual 16-core Neural Engine, and faster unified memory, MacBook Pro with M6 is faster and more responsive.

inlines.text: M6 brings even more performance and next-level AI capabilities to the 14-inch MacBook Pro. Featuring a powerful 12-core CPU, a 12-core GPU with Neural Accelerators in each core, Dual 16-core Neural Engine, and faster unified memory, MacBook Pro with M6 is faster and more responsive.

blocks.text: The 12-core CPU, with two more cores than before, brings blazing-fast single- and multithreaded performance, so users can fly through everything from multitasking across apps to compiling code to handling complex creative workflows. The 12-core GPU, also with two additional cores, delivers up to 30 percent faster graphics performance when compared to M5.2 Everything from 3D modeling to photo editing and gaming feels incredibly fast, enhanced by a third-generation ray-tracing engine and Dynamic Caching to optimize on-chip memory. It also brings up to 25 percent faster performance for on-device AI workloads, like LLM prompt processing, compared to M5.3 The Dual 16-core Neural Engine delivers up to 1.9x faster performance than M5 and works with the advanced GPU to dramatically accelerate AI workloads like image generation, Super Resolution, and AI upscaling.2 The Neural Engine also powers Apple Intelligence, enabling advanced and energy-efficient on-device AI processing. The 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 does all this with industry-leading performance per watt and up to 24 hours of battery life, the longest ever in a Mac. With 16GB of unified memory standard, configurable up to 32GB, and higher memory bandwidth up to 170GB/s, MacBook Pro makes multitasking and working with demanding apps and large projects even faster.

inlines.text: There’s never been a better time for customers to upgrade from a previous-generation MacBook Pro with Apple silicon or an Intel-based Mac. The 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 delivers remarkable value thanks to major performance improvements and powerful AI capabilities. The new 14-inch MacBook Pro also features all of the compelling capabilities that have made it so popular, including:
Phenomenal battery life

: In addition to the huge leap in performance, battery life gets up to 14 additional hours for Intel-based upgraders and up to four more hours for users coming from M1, delivering up to 24 hours overall, so users can get more done on a single charge. Users coming from Intel-based and M1 systems will also get 16GB of starting unified memory, an additional Thunderbolt port, and the space black finish with an anodization seal for fewer fingerprints.
A brilliant pro display

: The stunning Liquid Retina XDR display delivers up to 1600 nits of peak HDR brightness and a 1,000,000:1 contrast ratio, bringing HDR photos and videos to life with deep blacks, brilliant highlights, and vibrant colors. And for users working in bright or challenging lighting conditions, a nano-texture display option dramatically reduces reflections and glare.
Powerful connectivity

: Now with Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6, the 14-inch MacBook Pro delivers fast wireless performance and low latency, along with support for up to two external displays. Its versatile array of ports — including the HDMI, MagSafe 3, and three Thunderbolt 4 ports; an SDXC card slot; and a headphone jack — makes it easy to connect high-speed peripherals, transfer photos, or expand a workspace.
Advanced camera, mics, and speakers

: A 12MP Center Stage camera with Desk View helps keep users perfectly framed on video calls, while a studio-quality three-mic array and amazing six-speaker sound system with Spatial Audio deliver an immersive audio experience.
Fast charging
: MacBook Pro with M6 supports fast charging, reaching up to 50 percent charge in just 30 minutes when paired with a compatible higher-wattage USB-C power adapter, such as the 96W Power Adapter.3
A laptop that’s built to last
: With an enclosure made from 100 percent recycled aluminum, MacBook Pro is exceptionally durable and can stand up to everyday use for years to come.
Better together with iPhone

: When used together with Continuity, iPhone and Mac are even more powerful — letting users move seamlessly across devices to share files and photos, hand off tasks, and even control their iPhone from their 14-inch MacBook Pro.5 Users switching to Mac for the first time can use iPhone to conveniently and securely transfer settings, files, photos, passwords, and more.

blocks.text: 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 and the Environment

inlines.text: 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 and the Environment

blocks.text: The new 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 was built with the environment in mind and drives progress toward Apple’s ambitious plan to be carbon neutral across its entire footprint by 2030. It is made with 45 percent recycled content overall,6 including 100 percent recycled aluminum in the enclosure, 100 percent recycled cobalt in the battery, and, in a first for Apple, 100 percent recycled tantalum in multiple capacitors. It is manufactured with 60 percent renewable electricity, such as wind and solar, across the supply chain. The 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 is designed to be durable and repairable, and meets Apple’s high standards for energy efficiency and safe chemistry. As with all Apple products, its paper packaging is 100 percent fiber-based7 and designed to be recycled.
